provenance.scope: The two honesty slots of every exhibit the vitrine opens: the twenty five pictures of the picture room and the machines. `limit` says what the evidence behind the work does not settle. `visual_note` says what the museum's view adds to the work or refuses to show. One sentence each, English and German, keyed by the exhibit id of data/lines.json.
provenance.rule: Every sentence rests on a record the museum already holds, named in `source`: the picture register and the store record of the plate the reclassification displays, the display windows, the machine dossiers and their evidence records. A slot the records give nothing for is null and is listed in the seat's STATUS.
provenance.read: Behind the record's control, in the slots `limit` and `visual_note` of the vitrine's exhibit.
